decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the new fiat-buyer FAQ section, including email confirmation, dashboard access, wallet provisioning, and reward collection.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that a Transak fiat buyer's confirmation email contains the NFT mint number as the referral code.
The same-message INTRODUCE already captures the read-only default, PDF.js viewer, dashboard and email-certificate entry points, and optional offline download.
The certificate and confirmation-email change does not alter the identity of the NFT ebook delivered by mint fulfillment.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures Transak wallet provisioning and direct NFT delivery; the email-certificate change requires no further payment-flow update.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records automatic prize transfer, removes the obsolete claim interaction, and adds email and dashboard notifications.
Including NFT details and the mint number in a confirmation email does not change which fields must be visible in on-chain NFT metadata.
The source discusses coded referrals and fiat-buyer reward access but does not change reward routing for mints without a referral code.
References to the $15 mint and $5 referral commission restate existing amounts and do not modify the mint revenue allocation.
The source does not change badge thresholds, award conditions, or the highest referral milestone.
The source contains no decision about secondary-sale royalties or their enforcement.
The source mentions draw frequencies and reward access but does not change the sale types or duration used to fund prize pools.
